title: Find how far a shadow price holds
heading: A Shadow Price Holds Only Over a Range
cases: the upper end of the range is the next right-hand side at which the price changes
the range extends below the current right-hand side too, down to the previous breakpoint
when the price holds all the way to a search limit, that limit itself is the end
a right-hand side at which the model has no optimal plan is outside the range
